dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Data are based on information in a US-EPA LCA study about LCD and CRT production. The data represent the backlight unit of a 15inch LCD computer screen, as it is produced in Japan. 2023 updates: The reduction in electricity and heat consumption is assumed to be 22.5% according to the data from (Cantini et al., 2022). However, since the production of fluorescent lighting is now scattered worldwide, including in America based on the recent market share data (MMR, 2022), the global electricity mix is used instead of a China-Japan mix; Geography: Data from literature (based on information from Japanese producers) – used as data for the global production average; UUID: 1be9866e-db97-3a13-8889-18fca3649486

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
CCFL containing backlight unit for a LCD computer screen

# Included processes
This module includes the material and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the production of the cold cathode fluorescent lamp (CCFL), the backlight light guide as well as for the subsequent backlight unit assembly. Estimations for infrastructure and transport of the raw materials are included as well.
